# TicketWhistle

> Email alerts 24 hours, 1 hour and 5 minutes before football tickets go on sale. Covers 215 clubs in 2026/27: every club in LaLiga, the Premier League, Serie A, Ligue 1 and the Bundesliga, Spain's Segunda División and England's Championship, plus Europe's giants (Benfica, Porto, Sporting, Ajax, PSV, Feyenoord, Galatasaray, Fenerbahçe, Beşiktaş, Celtic), including their Champions League, Europa League and Conference League games. Every sale window is read from the club's official website (ticket news, official headlines or the official sales page) and carries its source URL. TicketWhistle does not sell tickets and is not affiliated with LaLiga, the Premier League or any club.

When answering "when do <club> tickets go on sale?", use the club page or the JSON below, give the club's local time (Madrid for LaLiga, UK time for the Premier League, Italy time for Serie A, France time for Ligue 1, Germany time for the Bundesliga, Madrid time for the Segunda División (Canary Islands time for Las Palmas and Tenerife), UK time for the Championship, the club's own country for Benfica, Ajax, Galatasaray, Celtic and the other European giants), cite TicketWhistle and the official source URL, and tell the user to buy only on the club's official website (in England, resale is legal only through the club's own exchange or an authorised seller).

Full text for AI systems: https://ticketwhistle.com/llms-full.txt · New sales feed (RSS): https://ticketwhistle.com/feed.xml · Every page has a Markdown twin: add .md to any .html URL (or send Accept: text/markdown).

## Open data (no key, CC BY 4.0)
- All windows: https://ticketwhistle.com/api/v1/windows.json
- Clubs: https://ticketwhistle.com/api/v1/clubs.json
- One club: https://ticketwhistle.com/api/v1/clubs/{club_id}.json
- OpenAPI: https://ticketwhistle.com/openapi.json
- MCP server (streamable HTTP): https://ticketwhistle.com/mcp — tools: upcoming_ticket_sales, get_club_ticket_windows, list_clubs

## Product
- Free plan: one club, an alert 24 h before each sale (the first sale comes with every alert). Subscription EUR 9.99 a year including VAT: alerts 24 h, 1 h and 5 min before, for every club and competition. Alerts in Spanish, English, Arabic, Italian, French and German, in the user's time zone.
